text:
Meera Patel: Anyone have a last-green for main? linux-x86-release is red on batched-alloc-test across several shards. Job orch/main/linux-x86-release#4221. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/4221

Jonas Kim: I saw failures come in earlier. Looks correlated with recent allocator changes. Pulling logs now.

ci-bot: Build failed: orch/main/linux-x86-release#4221 - batched-alloc-test. Exit: timeout after 14m. Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/4221/logs

Priya Rao: I can kick off a bisect on a runner. Do we have a suspected commit range?

Meera Patel: No pointer yet. Test times out in `alloc_shard_test::stress` after ~14m consistently. If someone has last-green commit SHA paste it.

Jonas Kim: Potential suspects: commits touching allocator in range 7a1d2b..c3f4e5 (recent merge series).

Jonas Kim: Suggest bisect command:
```
git checkout main
git bisect start c3f4e5 7a1d2b
git bisect run ./tools/ci/run-batched-alloc-test.sh
```

SRE Oncall: I'll try a quick revert in staging of 7a1d2b and trigger a presubmit. Won't merge to main until we see results. ETA ~12m.

Priya Rao: If bisect takes too long, a targeted revert of the allocator batch-size flip (PR #8119) might be quicker to validate. That change was in 7a1d2b.

Meera Patel: Good plan. Jonas can you draft the revert PR and tag @eng-infra? Priya, can you run bisect in parallel and reduce concurrency to see if it's a race?

Jonas Kim: Drafting PR now. Also starting a repro job with shard concurrency lowered to 2 to see if it passes.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by Jonas Kim: orch/main/linux-x86-release#4222 queued.

Priya Rao: FYI KV-cache changes in c3f4e5 touched the same allocator path, but I don't think they're the root cause. Mentioning just in case.

SRE Oncall: If revert PR lands we'll gate the merge until CI stabilizes. I'll coordinate with infra to avoid surprising Dedicated clusters.

Jonas Kim: PR created: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/8229 - revert allocator-batch-size-change. Marked emergency, reviewers @eng-infra. Please do not merge until CI completes.

ci-bot: Build passed: orch/main/linux-x86-release#4222 (after reduced concurrency run).

Meera Patel: That pass is a useful signal — likely a concurrency/regression. Jonas continue bisect, Priya follow up on allocator flags and test harness.

Priya Rao: Will run bisect and report back the first failing commit. If we get a single culprit we can craft smaller fix instead of full revert.

SRE Oncall: I'll watch PR 8229 and hold merge until we confirm green across shards. Ping me when bisect result available.

Jonas Kim: Noted. Posting updates here from bisect job and CI. Thanks everyone.
